scope: The real Notes web application and local Go BFF use synthetic data. Evidence records the exact backend and which scenarios use the local OIDC issuer or fake gRPC Notes service.

features.title: Use the configured subpath and announcements

assertions.timeoutAlertText: The request took too long. Try again.
assertions.ariaSnapshotExcerpt: - main: |   - heading "Notes" [level=1] |   - form "New note": |     - text: Title |     - textbox "Title": slow request |     - text: Body |     - textbox "Body" |     - button "Create note"

evidence.exactSource: web/e2e/hosted.spec.mjs ('the page loads under the base path...', 'the preflight passes...', 'errors and status are announced', 'a reload under the base path keeps working'); deploy/gcp/inputs/example.inputs.json
evidence.scenario: Serve web app under configured hosted basePath (/bazel-protobuf-bff-template/) on a distinct origin from bff-dev --store=grpc: prove subpath asset loading, 404 at root /config.json, CORS preflight, reload survival, and ARIA live announcements ([role=status] 'Working...' & [role=alert]) + ariaSnapshot tree.
evidence.grpc60Boundary: Exercised fake-notes-grpc via cross-origin bff-dev --store=grpc under configured subpath /bazel-protobuf-bff-template/.

evidence.exactSource: web/e2e/notes.spec.mjs ('a second submit does not create a second note'); web/app/App.tsx
evidence.scenario: Submit Create note twice rapidly via dblclick before the first response resolves; app suppresses duplicate POST so only 1 HTTP CreateNote request and 1 saved receipt exist.
evidence.grpc60Boundary: Exercised fake-notes-grpc via bff-dev --store=grpc (exactly 1 CreateNote RPC emitted on dblclick).

evidence.exactSource: web/e2e/notes.spec.mjs ('after a validation error, focus returns to the first invalid field...', 'the keyboard alone creates a note and opens it, with focus visible throughout') at 320x568
evidence.scenario: At narrow 320x568 layout using keyboard alone: trigger required-title error, verify visible focus ring returns to Title with aria-describedby error message, type to clear error immediately, then Create and Open note with Tab/Enter and zero horizontal overflow.
evidence.grpc60Boundary: Exercised fake-notes-grpc via bff-dev --store=grpc (CreateNote + GetNote over HTTP/2 application/grpc).

features.title: Recover from refused or obsolete sessions

assertions.replayAlert: This sign-in did not start in this tab. Try again.

evidence.exactSource: web/e2e/signin.spec.mjs ('a declined sign-in is reported...', 'a deep link carrying another tab's answer is refused', 'a failed callback clears a session...', 'changing the client invalidates an earlier session', 'removing sign-in configuration prevents reuse...'); web/app/signin/oidc.ts
evidence.scenario: Exercise all five production OIDC failure & obsolete-session recovery paths: declined authorization, replayed cross-tab callback, error=access_denied callback clearing an active session, client_id change invalidation, and removed sign-in config blocking stale credential reuse.
evidence.grpc60Boundary: IMPORTANT #60 BOUNDARY: Runs against production //bff/cmd/bff (--store=memory) + OIDC verifier + synthetic issuer.mjs; fake-notes-grpc (#60) is testonly and excluded from production binary.

features.title: Sign in, reload, and sign out

evidence.exactSource: web/e2e/signin.spec.mjs ('the sign-in yields a verified identity, and the calls carry it', 'a reload keeps the session in this tab, and signing out forgets it'); web/app/signin/{SignIn.tsx,oidc.ts}; //bff/cmd/bff
evidence.scenario: Drive production //web/app:dist against //bff/cmd/bff and synthetic OIDC issuer: verify pre-auth refusal, PKCE sign-in, private CreateNote, session persistence across tab reload, explicit Sign out, and post-sign-out refusal + reload cleanliness without exposing JWT credentials.
evidence.grpc60Boundary: IMPORTANT #60 BOUNDARY: Production //bff/cmd/bff excludes testonly //bff/testing/grpcstore (#60); OIDC sign-in/reload/sign-out ran against real //bff/cmd/bff (--store=memory) + real OIDC verifier + synthetic issuer.mjs.

features.title: Launch the complete stack, restart and explicitly reset it

evidence.exactSource: web/e2e/local-stack.spec.mjs ('one command brings the whole stack up; a note survives a restart and not a reset'); tools/dev/dev.sh; tools/dev/profile.json
evidence.scenario: Run tools/dev/dev.sh three times: initial one-command BFF_STORE=local launch creating 'Demo', full process restart verifying persistence for ana + refusal for bob, then '--reset' removing data dir so the old note ID yields 'Not found.'.
evidence.grpc60Boundary: Runs real tools/dev/dev.sh with --store=local on-disk persistence (required to demonstrate local data-dir persistence and --reset wipe); fake-notes-grpc (#60) is separately tested under --store=grpc.

features.title: Handle a stopped server and a rendering failure

assertions.stoppedError: The service is unavailable. Try again.
assertions.renderError: The page failed to render. Reload to continue.
assertions.cliStoppedStderr: notes-cli: rpc error [unavailable]: service unreachable: [Errno 61] Connection refused

evidence.exactSource: web/e2e/notes.spec.mjs ('a stopped server is unavailable and a restart is not assumed', "a render error shows the boundary's message, not a blank page"); web/app/ErrorBoundary.tsx
evidence.scenario: Stop the real Go BFF process mid-session and confirm clean unavailable message; independently trigger #planted-render-error to prove React ErrorBoundary shows reload instruction instead of a blank page.
evidence.grpc60Boundary: Uses startStack('/') because stopServer() isolates Go BFF SIGTERM independently of fake-notes-grpc (#60); baseline unavailable fault against grpcstore already filmed in Round 1.

assertions.cliMissingRefStderr: notes-cli: rpc error [not_found]: note not found

evidence.exactSource: web/e2e/notes.spec.mjs ('not found', "another principal's note reads as not found"); bff/transport/handlers.go
evidence.scenario: Contrast an unused valid reference (notes/does-not-exist) against another user's private note (bob opening ana's note): both yield identical 'Not found.' without existence leaks.
evidence.grpc60Boundary: Exercised fake-notes-grpc via bff-dev --store=grpc (GetNote + CreateNote + cross-owner GetNote over HTTP/2 application/grpc).
